records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Works!
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Clearwater Works* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 3 (2026-06-29), showing some initial momentum, but no key milestone, no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:e5601277] in 4+ days. Solo Starter account with 8 days left; silence after early setup suggests moderate-low odds of unaided activation.

draft.subject: Getting your first project moving in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks is usually the step that makes the rest click.

If it would help to have someone alongside you, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Priya
